notes.title: Neon Death Drop DEMO is now live!!
notes.content:
Listen up queens! The demo for Neon Death Drop is officially LIVE!

Play 30 minutes of the STUNNING opening act of the game!

Slay the Bots down and rack up the highest score possible by using Seraph's full arsenal of stunts.

Join our community Discord to provide feedback and chat with the devs! 
https://discord.gg/fjQ6GUgJpF

notes.title: Dev update - Demo coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey all you fabulous friends! We have been busy little beavers as of late. Here’s a quick list of some of the features we’ve gently inserted into the game:
[list]
[*] New vaporwave environment
[*] New tutorial level
[*] New title screen
[*] New pause menu
[*] Dynamic maps with multiple levels that Seraph can pole-dance between!!
[/list]

Pretty soon we’ll launch a public playable demo along with a Discord channel to collect feedback from everyone. Stay tuned and keep dancin’!
